basic_info.description: Situated in a prime Pacific Heights location steps from Alta Plaza park, 2921 Washington #1 is a charming condominium in a boutique six unit complex built in 1916. Step into the +/- 1070 square foot home and there are beautifully refinished hardwood floors, a light filled living room with home office nook, and spacious formal dining room with Bay window. The kitchen has been updated with quartz counters, and there is an adjacent in-unit stacked washer and dryer. A peaceful bedroom is in the back of the floor plan away from any traffic, with an adjoining bath that can be accessed from either the bedroom or the hallway, for guests. A large storage room is included. Low dues of $550 per month include building insurance, water, heat and maintenance. Conveniently located to the Fillmore shopping and dining corridors as well as the upper Sacramento and Laurel Heights commercial districts, this is a great property.
